notes.key_messages: Candidates are reminded to read questions carefully and check answers thoroughly, especially in extended answers where more writing is required. The accurate use of chemical terminology is welcomed, as it removes ambiguity from responses. notes.general_comments: General comments This examination paper provided a difficult challenge to the candidates. The majority of candidates were able to finish the paper within the hour allowed. Questions 7, 8, 18 and 23 were found to be easy. Questions 14, 20, 25, 31, 38 and 39 were found to be particularly difficult.
